name: Dihexyltryptamine
summary: Dihexyltryptamine (DHT), or N,N-dihexyltryptamine, is a drug of the tryptamine family related to serotonergic psychedelics like dimethyltryptamine (DMT). It is an analogue in the structural series of N,N-dialkylated tryptamines that also includes DMT, diethyltryptamine (DET), dipropyltryptamine (DPT), dibutyltryptamine (DBT), and diamyltryptamine (DAT).
